summary:
Redesign apps/bayes-group-site as a senior engineering and consulting firm site. The stack stays the same: Vite + React + TS + react-router, plain CSS tokens, system fonts, prerendered static pages, hydration, and no backend or third-party scripts.

New pieces:
- A shared inline-SVG ArchitectureDiagram component, a Photo component (srcset, sizes, lazy loading) and a consistent line-icon set.
- Two new pages, /systems and /engagements, each prerendered with its own title, description, Open Graph tags and canonical link.
- A richer Home: credibility strip, Who we serve, systems band, pillars with photos, How we work plus Operate & improve, illustrative example engagements, placeholder testimonial, Why The Bayes Group and the CTA band.
- Two-column Services headers, a Training photo banner with format icons, About avatars and value icons, Contact in two columns with an optional Company size select, and a 404 bell-curve illustration.
- The header nav becomes Services, Systems, Training, Engagements, About, Contact; the footer gets columns.
- The sitemap lists seven pages, and DEPLOYMENT.md is updated.

These changes alter existing behavior, so the matching existing tests will be updated:
- the Home hero secondary button,
- the nav and footer link sets,
- the empty contact form now including companySize,
- the custom-development service items,
- the prerendered and sitemap page lists.

Tokens (src/styles/theme.css, src/theme/tokens.ts):
- Keep the existing tokens.
- Add --color-navy-deep #071528, --color-surface-teal #F2F7F7, --color-hairline #E3E8EF and --font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace.
- Set the type scale: hero h1 clamp to 38-40px on phones and 60-64px at ≥1024px; h2 28-32px on phones and 40-44px on desktop; body 17-18px with line-height 1.6.
- Section padding is 64px on phones and 96px on desktop; the container max-width is 1200px, centered; use an 8px spacing scale.
- Add a .eyebrow class: small, uppercase, teal, and on navy use the light teal. Every section has an eyebrow above its h2.
- Cards: radius 12px, 1px #E3E8EF border, soft shadow, translateY(-2px) on hover.
- Add .icon-tile: a 44px pale-teal rounded square that holds the icon.
- Add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block that removes all transitions, animations and transforms.
- html and body keep overflow-x: hidden. Use system fonts only, with no @import or url() to external hosts.

Photos (src/components/Photo.tsx, export function Photo({ name, alt, sizes, priority?, className? })): - Render . - Add loading="lazy" unless priority is set (only the home hero sets priority). - Use a descriptive, non-empty alt. Photos are never captioned or presented as the firm's own team or clients. - Where text sits on a photo, wrap it in a container with a navy gradient overlay (::after or a div) so the text meets WCAG AA.

Icons and motifs (src/components/Icons.tsx, src/components/Motifs.tsx):
- Draw every icon as a line icon on a 24x24 viewBox with fill="none", stroke="currentColor", stroke-width 1.5-2, aria-hidden="true" and focusable="false".
- Provide an icon for every service item, training format, engagement tier, systems capability, deliverable, credibility point and value, plus a check icon.
- In Motifs.tsx add BellCurveMotif and DataGridMotif background SVGs, both aria-hidden, plus a small BellCurveIllustration for the 404 page.

ArchitectureDiagram (src/components/ArchitectureDiagram.tsx, export function ArchitectureDiagram({ variant?: 'light' | 'dark' }) and default export):
- Render ONE <svg role="img" viewBox="..."> with no width or height attributes (CSS width:100%; height:auto).
- Its first children are <title> "System architecture: your systems, agent orchestration, models, guardrails and observability" and <desc> (non-empty). Set aria-labelledby to their ids, built with useId (or fixed ids) so they are hydration-safe.
- Every label is a <text> element in the monospace font (font-family var(--font-mono) via class) and at least 12px when rendered on phones. Labels, exactly:
  - Top row: 'Your systems', containing 'CRM', 'ERP', 'Data warehouse', 'Documents'.
  - Middle row: 'Agent orchestration', containing 'Planner', 'Tool-using agents', 'Human approval'.
  - Beside the orchestration row: 'Models (vendor-neutral)' and 'Guardrails & evaluations'.
  - Bottom, spanning the full width: 'Observability', containing 'Traces', 'Metrics', 'Cost', 'Evaluations'.
- Lines: arrow <line>/<path> elements with marker-end from Your systems to orchestration and between orchestration and Models. Dashed lines (stroke-dasharray) run from every box down to Observability.
- The 'dark' variant uses white and teal; 'light' uses navy and teal.
- Optionally render a second, vertically stacked svg for phones toggled by CSS. If you do, both must contain the same labels, and the hidden one must be display:none, not aria-hidden content duplicated for screen readers.

acceptance_files.test_acceptance.py:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Runs the app's acceptance tests: the Jest files in __tests__/acceptance/. Generated by the pipeline; the tests
themselves are locked files written by the planner. ACCEPTANCE_MILESTONE=N runs only the tests of milestones 1..N."""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
os.chdir(here)
if not os.path.isdir("node_modules"):
    lock = os.path.exists("package-lock.json")
    subprocess.run(["npm", "ci" if lock else "install", "--include=dev", "--no-audit", "--no-fund"], check=False, timeout=1500)
cmd = ["npx", "jest", "--ci", "__tests__/acceptance"]
m = os.environ.get("ACCEPTANCE_MILESTONE", "")
if m.isdigit():
    cmd += ["-t", "^(" + "|".join("M%d" % i for i in range(1, int(m) + 1)) + "): "]
# The app's own test script may add node flags (e.g. --experimental-vm-modules): use the same ones.
try:
    script = json.load(open("package.json")).get("scripts", {}).get("test", "")
except (OSError, ValueError):
    script = ""
env = dict(os.environ)
if "--experimental-vm-modules" in script:
    env["NODE_OPTIONS"] = (env.get("NODE_OPTIONS", "") + " --experimental-vm-modules").strip()
print("Running: " + " ".join(cmd), flush=True)
sys.exit(subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, timeout=1500).returncode)
